name: Scorpaddle
ability: Swift Swim / Battle Armor / Tough Claws (hidden)
look: a round yellow sea scorpion with a stepped magenta stripe down its ringed shell, big dark eyes, brown swimming paddles and a pink telson spike
entry: A sea scorpion from the oldest oceans. It rows along the sea floor with its paddles and holds its tail spike up like a warning, though the spike was only ever for show.
how: Revive a Telson Fossil at a Restoration Tank. Telson Fossils are found by brushing the suspicious gravel of fossil beds on the sea floor.
